e.title: Ensuro
e.summary: 区块链持牌再保协议（22★）：链上参数险承保（合规持牌保险公司托管资本）
e.body: Ensuro（ensuro/ensuro，22★）是基于区块链的持牌（再）保险协议：链上参数险（parametric）承保——以持牌保险公司为托管实体管理资本，链上自动化承保/定价/赔付（eTokens 资本池模式）。对 RIAA：链上参数险协议的另一范式（持牌合规路线）——与 [[nexus-mutual]]（互助 DAO）、[[etherisc-gif]]（通用框架）、[[hurricaneguard]]（参数险产品）对照区块链保险治理模式；参数险定价衔接 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 的逻辑；理解 eTokens 资本池（流动性提供）与传统再保资本的区别。
e.verified_note: repo 页核实：Ensuro 区块链持牌再保协议（参数险 eTokens 资本池），22★
e.summary_en: Blockchain-based licensed (re)insurer protocol (22★): on-chain parametric underwriting with capital managed by licensed insurers
e.summary_hk: 區塊鏈持牌再保協議（22★）：鏈上參數險承保（合規持牌保險公司託管資本）
e.body_en: Ensuro (ensuro/ensuro, 22★) is a blockchain-based licensed (re)insurer protocol: on-chain parametric underwriting — with licensed insurers acting as custodial entities managing capital, and automated on-chain underwriting/pricing/payout (an eTokens capital-pool model). For RIAA: another paradigm of on-chain parametric insurance (the licensed-compliance route) — compare the blockchain-insurance governance models of [[nexus-mutual]] (mutual DAO), [[etherisc-gif]] (generic framework) and [[hurricaneguard]] (parametric product); the parametric pricing connects to [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]; understand how the eTokens capital pool (liquidity provision) differs from traditional reinsurance capital.
e.body_hk: Ensuro（ensuro/ensuro，22★）是基於區塊鏈的持牌（再）保險協議：鏈上參數險（parametric）承保——以持牌保險公司為託管實體管理資本，鏈上自動化承保/定價/賠付（eTokens 資本池模式）。對 RIAA：鏈上參數險協議的另一範式（持牌合規路線）——與 [[nexus-mutual]]（互助 DAO）、[[etherisc-gif]]（通用框架）、[[hurricaneguard]]（參數險產品）對照區塊鏈保險治理模式；參數險定價銜接 [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]] 的邏輯；理解 eTokens 資本池（流動性提供）與傳統再保資本的區別。
